findings.title: Superseded Runs Not Cancelled (Missing Concurrency or `cancel-in-progress: false`)
findings.evidence: 8 run(s) across 5 branch(es) were superseded (a newer run started before they finished) in the sampled window; ~30–288 runner-min/mo of superseded compute (mean over 3 timed run(s); ×0.57 to the 30d volume (57 runs); 100-run recent slice (not a full 30d census)). Superseded attribution is INFERENCE — the API marks no run 'cancelled-by-concurrency'.
findings.measured_signal: overlap-confirmed superseded runs x mean job-minutes (8 confirmed; naive 77; 3 timed run(s); scale 0.57)
findings.size_note: runner-minute (bill) only — superseded runs don't gate the merge (the latest run does); range is lower(overlap-confirmed)–upper(naive runs-1).

measured_evidence.summary: 8 run(s) across 5 branch(es) were superseded (a newer run started before they finished) in the sampled window; ~30–288 runner-min/mo of superseded compute (mean over 3 timed run(s); ×0.57 to the 30d volume (57 runs); 100-run recent slice (not a full 30d census)). Superseded attribution is INFERENCE — the API marks no run 'cancelled-by-concurrency'.
measured_evidence.note: Superseded = a run a NEWER run started before it finished — measured by timestamp overlap, so sequential (non-racing) commits are NOT charged. Cancellation cause is unknowable from the API, so the attribution is INFERENCE. Basis: the count is from the all-status slice (100 runs); the per-run PRICE is the mean of 3 PR-success timed runs (superseded runs' own jobs aren't fetched) — different populations. GUARDRAIL: verify this is NOT a deploy/release/publish workflow (a mid-flight run may be uploading artifacts / pushing a tag) before enabling cancellation — and take the predicate from the catalog recipe, which scopes cancellation with an expression; never a bare `cancel-in-progress: true`, which also kills in-flight runs on the default branch and on release tags. ROUTING: this workflow triggers on `push` — with a `pull_request` trigger use the catalog's DEFAULT (PR-scoped) predicate; without one, the PR-scoped predicate is never true and saves nothing, so use the catalog's WIDENED predicate.

tier2_neutrality.ref: superseded runs: same head_branch, a newer run started before this one finished (timestamp overlap); cancellation cause is inference
